patthana23.51:1.1: dhammaṃ paccayā anidassana appaṭigho parittārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana23.51:2.1: na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ na mahaggatārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā anidassana appaṭigho mahaggatārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana23.51:3.1: na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ na appamāṇārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā anidassana appaṭigho appamāṇārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi. na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ na hīnaṃ
